start.text: You come up over the lip of the notch, and Cindermoor goes on up in front of you in long steps — long shelves of black cinder and brown heather, one above another, each a man's height over the last — into a fog so thick it's like walking into the side of a hill.
The road runs off west along the lowest step and stops a few yards on, the way it did below. A cold cresset stands at the lip beside you, and somewhere above, at the turns, there'll be others.
And above everything, far up and nearer than it was, the Hearthspire: pale, slender, dark at the top. From here you can see that the dark isn't the fog. It's the lantern room. Nothing in it.
